visualCharacteristics: Two-up promo grid. Each item stacks a heading, a short description, and a 'Read More' CTA link above a photographic image (image sits below the text).
contentPattern: One row per promo item. Each row has a body cell (heading + description + CTA link) and an image cell; the body renders above the image.
usage: Members-only / featured promo pairs highlighting two stories, each with a call to action.
